items.name: eva-auto-badge
items.title: Eva Auto Badge
items.description: Content-sized interface labels whose frame grows around one or two text levels.
items.docs: EvaAutoBadge derives its width and height from the rendered labels, typography, padding, gap, rule, and border. The wider text level sets the frame width, so adding a shorter secondary label only adds height. Use size for coordinated defaults, or override fontSize, secondaryFontSize, paddingInline, paddingBlock, gap, borderWidth, cornerRadius, and separatorThickness. horizontalScale changes both the visible type and measured frame width.

items.name: eva-badge
items.title: Eva Badge
items.description: Auto-fitting interface labels with adjustable frame geometry, one or two text levels, and an optional separator.
items.docs: The size prop controls the whole frame. Explicit width, height, padding, borderWidth, cornerRadius, gap, and separatorThickness values override the preset and generic style values. Use shape="square" for hard corners; it always overrides cornerRadius. Both text zones fit themselves to the available area, while horizontalScale controls optical width. Use align, tracking, and uppercase for typography. Add secondary for a second level, separator for the internal rule, emphasis="secondary" when the lower level should dominate, and lang="ja" for Japanese interface text.

items.name: eva-text
items.title: Eva Text
items.description: Display typography with Evangelion-inspired font roles, tracking, and horizontal scaling.
items.docs: Horizontal scaling changes the rendered shape without changing layout width. Use it for headings and labels, not body-copy wrapping.
